data.name: Andy
data.gender_notes: Andy is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Andronikos, a Greek name composed of andros (man) and nikos (victory). This name signifies a man or warrior, and was borne by several saints in Christian history. The name Andy carries the meaning “Man, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andy usually hope their child will grow to embody man, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing courage and strength in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Andy belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Andy total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Andy has its origins in Greek culture and means 'man' or 'warrior'. Historically, it was the name of several Christian saints and martyrs. Today, it is a common name in many English-speaking countries, and it is often associated with friendliness, approachability, and informality due to the popular children's character Andy from the Peanuts comics and TV shows.
data.spiritual_significance: Andy is a name that carries a strong spiritual impact, as it is derived from the Greek name Andronikos, which literary means 'man of victory' or 'man of God'. It can also be a source of encouragement and inspiration, reminding us that as followers of Christ, we are warriors in the spiritual battle and can overcome any challenge with His help and grace.
